ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: on the left side of the figure is a gray equilateral triangle RST, and on the right side is a gray triangle TUV obtained by rotating it about point T; the two triangles share point T. The dashed segment connects from S to V. In the figure, 70° is marked at point T; this angle is located between ray TR and ray TV. From the figure, ray TR is located between ray TS and ray TV. Reasoning: Because RST is an equilateral triangle, ∠RTS = ∠RST = 60°. The rotation is performed about point T and maps S to V, so TS = TV. Since ∠RTV = 70°, and TR is between TS and TV, ∠STV = ∠STR + ∠RTV = 60° + 70° = 130°. In triangle STV, TS = TV, so it is an isosceles triangle, and the base angles ∠TSV = ∠SVT = (180° - 130°)/2 = 25°. Also because ∠RST = 60°, and the dashed line SV is inside ∠RST, ∠RSV = 60° - 25° = 35°.

raw_record.question_text: The diagram shows an equilateral triangle RST and the triangle TUV obtained by rotating triangle RST about the point T. Angle RTV = 70^{\circ}. What is angle RSV?

method.method_draft: First describe the diagram: RST is the left shaded equilateral triangle, TUV is the rotated shaded triangle on the right sharing vertex T, V is connected to S by a dotted segment, and the marked 70° angle at T is between TR and TV. From the text, use that RST is equilateral, so ∠RTS = ∠RST = 60°, and that rotation about T sends S to V, so TS = TV. Since the image shows ray TR lying between ray TS and ray TV around T, compute ∠STV = ∠STR + ∠RTV = 60° + 70° = 130°. Then triangle STV is isosceles with TS = TV, so its base angles are (180° − 130°)/2 = 25°. Thus ∠TSV = 25°. Finally, at S in the equilateral triangle, ∠RST = 60°, and the dotted ray SV lies inside that angle, so ∠RSV = 60° − 25° = 35°.

method.method_draft: Use an analytic coordinate setup matching the diagram. Place S = (0,0) and T = (1,0), with equilateral triangle RST above segment ST, so R = (1/2, √3/2) and ray TR makes a 120° direction from the positive x-axis. The image shows V above and to the right of T, and the given ∠RTV = 70° means ray TV is 70° clockwise from ray TR, so TV has direction 120° − 70° = 50°. Because TUV is a rotation of RST about T, TV equals TS in length, so TV = 1. Hence V = (1 + cos 50°, sin 50°). The direction angle of SV from the positive x-axis is arctan(sin 50°/(1 + cos 50°)) = arctan(tan 25°) = 25°, using the half-angle identity. Ray SR in the equilateral triangle makes a 60° angle from the positive x-axis. Therefore ∠RSV = 60° − 25° = 35°.

再推理：按解析几何设置坐标。令 S = (0,0)，T = (1,0)，等边三角形 RST 在 ST 上方，所以 R = (1/2, √3/2)。因此从 T 指向 R 的射线 TR 相对于正 x 轴的方向角是 120°。图中 V 在 T 的右上方，且 ∠RTV = 70°，所以射线 TV 是从 TR 顺时针转 70°，方向角为 120° - 70° = 50°。由于 TUV 是 RST 绕 T 旋转得到的，TV 的长度等于原三角形中从 T 到相应顶点的长度，也为 1。因此 V = (1 + cos 50°, sin 50°)。

现在求射线 SV 的方向角：tan(∠VST from x-axis) = sin 50° / (1 + cos 50°)。由半角恒等式 sin θ/(1+cos θ)=tan(θ/2)，可得该方向角为 arctan(tan 25°)=25°。而射线 SR 在等边三角形中与正 x 轴成 60°。所以 ∠RSV = 60° - 25° = 35°。
